name: 5143 tri-blade propeller, 5.1 x 4.3
summary: A one-piece glass-filled tri-blade propeller for 5-inch multirotors. Sample data: the supplier and every figure here are fictional.
partsNote: A one-piece moulding. The model shows it as one part with its critical areas marked.

evidence.summary: Supplier datasheet received. No sample yet.
checked: Figures as stated by the supplier
Supplier statement that moulding is done in Hsinchu

parts.name: One-piece moulding
parts.whatItDoes: Hub and three blades moulded in one shot from glass-filled polycarbonate. There are no separate internal parts.
parts.whyItMatters: Moulding quality sets balance and how the blades flex at high speed. Voids near the hub are where props crack.
buyingChecks: Ask for the polymer and filler content
Balance a few props from the same bag
Check the hub bore is a clean 5 mm fit with no flash

demand.reason: Propellers wear and break, so every fleet reorders them. Defence buyers reject drones with Chinese parts, which includes propellers.

sources.title: Army drone procurement and the ban on Chinese parts, Rediff and Business Standard, 23 Nov 2026
Drone Federation India white paper on import dependence, reported by Business Standard, 18 Nov 2026
